metadata.article_title: Injection to corporation binding on its officer.

article.title: Injection to corporation binding on its officer.
article.content:
5Injection to corporation binding on its officer.

Order 39, Rule 5
An injunction directed to a corporation is binding not only on the corporation itself, but also on all members and officers of the corporation whose personal action it seeks to restrain.
